title: agoseris aurantiaca subsp. purpurea
intro: Agoseris aurantiaca subsp. purpurea, commonly known as Orange Mariposa Daisy, is a flowering plant species native to North America, characterized by its bright orange or yellow daisy-like flowers. The plant has been traditionally used in herbal medicine for its potential health benefits, including the treatment of digestive issues, respiratory problems, and skin irritations. Its therapeutic actions are attributed to its anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and antibacterial properties, which may aid in soothing irritated tissues and promoting wound healing. The bioactive constituents of Agoseris aurantiaca subsp. purpurea include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
